mapper.select: SELECT BASE_MONTH FROM USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BASE_MONTH

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BASE_MONTH AS baseMonth, DEPOSIT_AMT AS depositAmt, INVESTMENT_AMT AS investmentAmt, REAL_ESTATE_AMT AS realEstateAmt, OTHER_ASSET_AMT AS otherAssetAmt, TOTAL_ASSET_AMT AS totalAssetAmt, NO_LOAN_YN AS noLoanYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = #{baseMonth}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO USER_ASSET_SNAPSHOT t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{baseMonth} AS BASE_MONTH FROM DUAL) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.BASE_MONTH = s.BASE_MONTH) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.DEPOSIT_AMT = #{depositAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.INVESTMENT_AMT = #{investmentAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.REAL_ESTATE_AMT = #{realEstateAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.OTHER_ASSET_AMT = #{otherAssetAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.TOTAL_ASSET_AMT = #{totalAssetAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.NO_LOAN_YN = #{noLoanYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, t.UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, DEPOSIT_AMT, INVESTMENT_AMT, REAL_ESTATE_AMT, OTHER_ASSET_AMT, TOTAL_ASSET_AMT, NO_LOAN_YN, CREATED_AT) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.BASE_MONTH, #{depositAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{investmentAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{realEstateAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{otherAssetAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAssetAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{noLoanYn,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{now})

MERGE INTO USER_INCOME_MONTH t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{baseMonth} AS BASE_MONTH FROM DUAL) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.BASE_MONTH = s.BASE_MONTH) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.INCOME_KIND_CODE = #{incomeKindCode}, t.INCOME_AMT = #{incomeAmt}, t.INPUT_DATE = #{inputDate}, t.UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, INCOME_KIND_CODE, INCOME_AMT, INPUT_DATE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.BASE_MONTH, #{incomeKindCode}, #{incomeAmt}, #{inputDate}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT WORK_PERIOD_MONTHS FROM APP_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, BASE_MONTH AS baseMonth, LOAN_TYPE_CODE AS loanTypeCode, BALANCE_AMT AS balanceAmt, ANNUAL_RATE_PCT AS annualRatePct, RATE_TYPE_CODE AS rateTypeCode, REMAINING_MONTHS AS remainingMonths, MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT AS monthlyPaymentAmt, SOURCE_CODE AS sourceCode, CONSENT_ID AS consentId FROM USER_LOAN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND BASE_MONTH = #{baseMonth} ORDER BY LOAN_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_LOAN (USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, LOAN_TYPE_CODE, BALANCE_AMT, ANNUAL_RATE_PCT, RATE_TYPE_CODE, REMAINING_MONTHS, MONTHLY_PAYMENT_AMT, SOURCE_CODE, CONSENT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{baseMonth}, #{loanTypeCode}, #{balanceAmt}, #{annualRatePct}, #{rateTypeCode}, #{remainingMonths}, #{monthlyPaymentAmt}, #{sourceCode}, #{consentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{now})

INSERT INTO USER_EXPENSE_ITEM (USER_ID, BASE_MONTH, EXPENSE_GROUP_CODE, EXPENSE_CATEGORY, DESCRIPTION, MONTHLY_AMT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{baseMonth}, #{expenseGroupCode}, #{expenseCategory,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{monthlyAmt}, #{now})
mapper.sql: USER_ID AS userId, BASE_DATE AS baseDate, CREDIT_HISTORY_DAYS AS creditHistoryDays, DELINQ_COUNT_12M AS delinqCount12m, NEW_LOAN_COUNT_3M AS newLoanCount3m, CARD_LIMIT_AMT AS cardLimitAmt, CARD_MONTHLY_SPEND_AMT AS cardMonthlySpendAmt, CARD_UTIL_PCT AS cardUtilPct, CASH_ADVANCE_MONTHS AS cashAdvanceMonths, PRIVATE_LENDER_LOAN_BALANCE_AMT AS privateLenderLoanBalanceAmt, SOURCE_CODE AS sourceCode
mapper.update: MERGE INTO USER_CREDIT_PROFILE t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{baseDate} AS BASE_DATE FROM DUAL) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.BASE_DATE = s.BASE_DATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.CREDIT_HISTORY_DAYS = #{creditHistoryDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.DELINQ_COUNT_12M = #{delinqCount12m,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.NEW_LOAN_COUNT_3M = #{newLoanCount3m,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.CARD_LIMIT_AMT = #{cardLimitAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.CARD_MONTHLY_SPEND_AMT = #{cardMonthlySpendAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.CARD_UTIL_PCT = #{cardUtilPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.CASH_ADVANCE_MONTHS = #{cashAdvanceMonths,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.PRIVATE_LENDER_LOAN_BALANCE_AMT = #{privateLenderLoanBalanceAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE t.SOURCE_CODE = 'MANUAL' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, BASE_DATE, CB_AVAILABLE_YN, CB_GRADE, CREDIT_HISTORY_DAYS, DELINQ_COUNT_12M, NEW_LOAN_COUNT_3M, CARD_LIMIT_AMT, CARD_MONTHLY_SPEND_AMT, CARD_UTIL_PCT, CASH_ADVANCE_MONTHS, PRIVATE_LENDER_LOAN_BALANCE_AMT, SOURCE_CODE, CONSENT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.BASE_DATE, 'N', NULL, #{creditHistoryDays,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{delinqCount12m,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{newLoanCount3m,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cardLimitAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cardMonthlySpendAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cardUtilPct,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{cashAdvanceMonths,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{privateLenderLoanBalanceAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'MANUAL', NULL, #{now})
